lines.speaker: Rohan Joshi
lines.text: It is highly possible that they also spoke about the cricket team, because if they are talking about this, then they won't be like, nuclear code five five five. They will be like, Sachin khel raha hai kya?

lines.speaker: Rohan Joshi
lines.text: Sachin didn't play in the '70s. I just look like him, that's all. Abish Mathew, hi, hi. Let's move on, guys.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: It's okay. Your people gave us Sanju Samson, all forgiven. You know why this is awesome? He's now going to go home and Google, who is Sanju Samson.

lines.speaker: Abish Mathew
lines.text: No, no, no. I don't know anything about cricket, but if there is a Malayali on anything, bro, I know this. I know Sanju Samson, Malayali. That's why I know cricket.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: Sanju Samson nahi, chutiye. Sanju Samson. Brother of Ravi OnePlus. What is happening?

uncertain: 'Sanju Samson nahi, chutiye' vs 'Samsung nahi, chutiye' (the OnePlus joke suggests a Samsung pun)
notes: Sarvam+keyterms replaced the punchline with 2 phantom show-name lines and a phantom 'Kaneez Surka'. 4o-diarize garbled 'Abish Mathew, hi hi' as 'Are we sned to high high'.
